title: Louis XVi Style Buffet
description: Some pieces whisper.  This one practically proposed!  The moment I laid eyes on this Louis XVI style buffet, it was game over.  If there had been even the slightest chance of shoehorning it into my house, I'd have found a way.  Structural integrity is merely a suggestion.  How's that for an endorsement?!

title: Old Paris Medici Vases - a Pair
description:
Charles X, ca. 1820-1830
Wear to gilding consistent with age, as shown in photos.

title: Henri II Style Bronze Sconces with cast face of Diane de Poitiers - A Pair
description: These epic candleholders are wall mounted and fabulous! The portrait of Diane de Poitiers only adds to their elegance. In good condition with some wax residue from previous use. The sconces date to the 1920's.

title: French Regency Period Armoire
description: Oh Boy!  This lovely French Regency armoire has the luster of hundreds of years of hand rubbed polish.  Fitted out in the 19th century with shelves and storage (ignore our mess) we use it for our blankies and bags.  We will be sad to see it go!  We have its original key (pictured) It's rare that I have a picture of the place where the piece actually came from (check out the last picture in the series.!)

title: Napoleon III Painted Tray on Custom Art Deco Wrought Iron Stand
description: I just about fell over when I found this tole tray on stand, it must have been in a very dark room its entire life, the paint is as vivid as the day it was made.  The later hand wrought iron stand dates from the 30s and is custom made to fit the tray.  The gold leaf is exquisite and the flowers and birds minutely detailed.  There are a few faint marks on the edges of the black where careless drinks were placed.  If i could squeeze this beauty in my house...... but I can't keep everything!

title: Louis XV Style Chair
description: The perfect accessory to a room is a good chair!  This walnut Louis XV style armchair could either be the finishing touch or the jumping off point.  Newly upholstered in a very light dove gray cut velvet in a more modern chevron pattern makes it easy to design around without having to invest in new upholstery.

title: Edwardian Hand Carved Marble Pedestals
description: This pair of carrera marble pedestals were done in the Edwardian era and in the Adams style. tall and slender they would make a wonderful statement in an entryway.

title: Louis XVI Period Mirror
description: wowza!  This Louis XVI period mirror has  been completely restored after someone in the 1980s slathered it in pink paint.  I think it's a wonderful result.  the mirror is in two sections because in the 18th century before the industrial revolution they couldn't make large, flat glass to be transformed into mirrors.  You can see examples of this at the hall of mirrors in Versailles.

title: Napoleon III Black Lacquered Desk
description: Wowza!  Now, THIS IS A DESK!  freshly re-laquered, it retains its original red leather with gilded tooling.  We placed glass on the surface to protect it and the new lacquer.  Check out the finely chiseled bronze accents and banding on this thing,  Just beautiful!

title: American Federal Portrait
description: Instant ancestors!  I love the idea of hanging this guy in the bathroom so he can look oh so judgmentally at you.....

title: Louis XV Style Canapé
description: ohhh baby baby!  This Lous XV style canapé from the 1920s is just back from the upholsterer!  We chose a glam dark gray silk velvet to accentuate the billion pounds of down in the cushions, there is nothing like the look of velvet down cushions.  The piece retains its original cream paint that offsets the gray perfectly.

title: Japanese Satsuma Lamp
description:
This fantastic lamp dates from ca. 1912. Newly rewired with new shade. 

The shade measures 17" in diameter; the base is 7" at its widest point.  In excellent condition as shown in photos.

title: French Rococo Revival Bronze Doré Candlesticks, 1860 - A Pair
description:
Circa 1860, French.
Heavily detailed.

title: Monumental French Louis XV Style Bergere
description: Comfy?  Yes!  roomy?  Yes!  Stylish? YES!  what more do you need to know besides that?  Well, here are a few more deets...  Crafted out of  solid walnut and newly upholstered in a lovely very light blue jacquard fabric with a matching velvet down filled seat makes this baby ready to put in any space.

title: 1920s Hand Carved Bo-Ho Mirror
description: Mirror, mirro on the wall... who's the most fabulous of them all?  This ridiculously detailed, hand-carved, polychromed beauty, that's who.  Sumptuous, unapologetically dramatic, and guaranteed to make every other mirror in the room question its life choices.  Hang it, admire yourself shamelessly and pretend you're European nobility.  We won't tell......

title: Georgian Style Arm Chair
description: Some days call for coffee.  Other days call for a Throne (not that kind!).  if you're feeling particularly queenly -or kingly- today, this George III reproduction has your name written all over it.  Just try not to start issuing royal decree's from the living room.... or do.  We don't judge.

title: Louis Xv Style Settee
description: Great color drenched chenille upholstery from the 1970s with tons of use left in it.  Have a seat in the oh so soft down cushions and just relax.  .

title: Milo Baughman for Coggin White Parson's Table.
description: oh baby baby, this slick, contemporary Milo Baughman table is the Bomb!  Great for small spaces or put the leaf in for more seating for those fab dinner parties you give!

title: Napoleon III Burled Walnut Ink Well and Stand
description: Carved, burled walnut finial with carved moveable pen holder.  ca. 1890, French.

title: 1860s French Urn With Religious Motif
description: ca. 1860, French. Old Paris. with wear consistent with age and use,  later over paint on wings of the griffin, shown in photographs.

title: French Choisy Le Roi Asparagus Server
description:
Circa 1890-1900. 
Minor wear consistent with age and use as shown in photos.

title: Brown French 19th Century Tobacco Jar With Berry and Ivy Details
description: Adorable French tobacco jar with lovely nature details, including unusual faux bois "pockets". Some wear on bottom and a chip on the lid, as shown in photos. Wear is consistent with age and history.

title: Small Oval French Faience Dish
description: Lovely, oval dish with branch and leaf details and a splash of violet and green glaze. Possibly from Marseilles. Some chipping and minor cracks on the bottom of the piece, as shown in the photos.

title: Brass Cannonball Andirons - A Pair
description: These oversized andirons have quite the visual impact! Dating from between 1900-1920, they are in excellent condition, as shown in photos.

title: Mid-Century Modern Frosted Tulip Lamp
description: This acrylic and frosted glass lamp from the 1960's, with bright gold accents, is a certainly a statement piece! The glass is a frosted purple and pink. The shade is new and measures 20 in diameter while the base is 6.75 square.

title: Egyptian Revival Bronze Candlesticks - A Pair
description: These bronze candle holders have fantastic female figures. Dating from the 1920's, they are in excellent condition, as shown in photos.

title: English Majolica Bulldog Pitcher
description: This charming English pitcher has quite the personality! In excellent condition, this is a must for any dog lover! Dates from between 1890 and 1900.

title: Louis Philippe Three Drawer Desk Commode
description: This chest of drawers comes with a hidden desk! The top drawer pulls out to create a small writing table with three drawers inside the desk area. Three larger drawers are below. A piece of black marble in excellent condition sits on top. Dates from the 1830's. Some wear to wood, especially on the top drawer, and the interior felt.

title: English Silver Plated Tray with Painted Brass Stand
description: An elegant English silver-plated tray presented on a painted brass stand, with a lovely worn-through vintage finish. Versatile as a drinks table or display surface in any traditional interior.

title: French Sterling Silver Sauce Boat in Francis I Pattern With as Monogram
description: This sauce boat is in excellent condition, with a wonderful monogram of "AS". Dates from between the 1900's and 1920's.

title: French Antique Napoleon III Fireplace Fender
description: This exquisite fireplace fender has been recently polished and brings a bit of sparkle and elegance to any fireplace front.  Dates to the 1870's and is in good condition, with a few minor dents.

title: Antique French Small Brass Cauldron With Wrought Iron Handle
description: This cauldron dates from the early 1900s and is in great condition. Tarnish appropriate to the age and use of the piece.

title: United States Army Silver Plate Ladle
description: This ladle dating from the 1960's and is labeled "MED DEPT USA".  In good condition, with tarnish consistent with age.

title: Napoleon III Black Lacquer and Gilt Center Table
description: Done up in the Louis XIII style in black lacquer with gilded accents this table certainly makes a statement!  I love the dramatic look it has.  I found this in France when I was rummaging around one of my favorite Brocantes near Toulouse.

title: Louis XV Style Converted Gasolier Sconces a Pair
description: Very Large Pair of Gasolier Bronze Louis XV style Sconces, newly re-wired and ready to hang to add that extra bit of bling to finish off a room.

title: American Fancy Spindle Chair
description: Charmingly crusty, this probably Valley of Virginia spindle chair still has part of its original green paint showing thru the yellow later paint.  The hand woven basket weave caning is probably original to the piece.  More art than furniture, this piece dates to the 1840s.

title: French Terra-Cotta Console
description: I bought this at an auction for a convent that was closing down near Montauban in France.  There were only 3 very elderly nuns left in residence and they were selling the contents and the building to give to charity, then were moving to their sister house in Narbonne.  It was used to display saint's statues in the large entryway.  I saw it and thought it would make a wonderful entryway statement as a hall console or left in the garden to weather gently in the elements.

title: Pottery Umbrella Stand
description: Possibly Weller, this periwinkle blue umbrella stand is as beautiful as it is colorful.  This will brighten up those dreary rainy days when your taking your umbrella out for a spin (or stealing someone else's, I think there is a Georges Brassens song about that).  In any case its wonderful!

title: 1920s French Style Basket Lantern
description: How is this for charming?  gilded iron and painted tole come together to make a wonderful and unusual lantern or chandelier.... imagine this hanging over a dinner table with ivy or orchids that have been placed in the receptacle hanging decorously down.  How cool!

title: French Wrought Iron Butcher's Rack
description: WTH?  I bet your asking yourself!  This 19th century wrought iron butcher's rack was used to suspend the smaller fresh produce displayed for sell (I'll let you imagine just what).  In any case this would be excellent for handing pots and pans from or dried herbs or flowers, let you imagination run wild (to erase the previous image, lol)

title: French 19th Century Dough Trough
description: I love this very large French 19th century baker's dough bowl.  When I saw it in a little antiques shop in Albi, I thought it would be beautiful filled with orchids.  Lovely patina and color perfect for an island or a kitchen table.

title: Charles X Old Paris Compotes Set of 3
description:
Beautiful hand painted with blue flowers and applied gilding, these will decorate your table or sideboard with elegance.  Fill them with fruit, dried flowers or just leave them empty.  Just gorgeous. 
sizes for the smaller sides.
H-7in
W-9in
D-9in

title: American Bleached Oak Desk
description: how pretty is this?  The finish was so old and dark we decided to strip and bleach it to give it a more airy, modern look.  Purportedly from the NYC public library study rooms I bought from a local estate here in Virginia.

title: French 4 Drawer Commode
description: Whats not to love?  This unusually narrow Louis XIV style chest is the perfect size for that perfect place, it's kinda like a goldilocks thing.  I found it in France at one my favorite Brocantes in Cordes-sur-Ciel (you really should visit, its beautiful).

title: Industrial Lamps a Pair
description: wonderful pair of industrial salvage industrial pieces transformed into lamps.   I suspect these were part of a thresher.

title: Aubusson Tapestry Panels Set of 4
description: Just. Loverly.  This set of 4 Napoleon III tapestry panels will give you that finishing touch or an excellent starting point to design the room around.  Completely restored and mounted on linen with over engineered steel hangers and weights to keep them taut and flat against the wall.

title: Solid Brass MCM Dining Table
description: I can just see Halston eating caviar at this table with Liza!  it is spectacular!  solid brass with a greek key motif and beautifully detailed feet.  This is truly a glitz bomb!

title: American Baroque Corner Chair
description: Need some bling?!  This gilded American piece certainly fits the bill.  In typical late 19th century style this lovely pice is in great shape.  It would look spectacular in a black room.

title: Louis XVI Style Arm Chair
description: Who doesn't need a little glam in their lives?  This Gilded Louis XVI style chair with it's original upholstery certainly fits that bill!

title: Louis XV Style Arm Chairs a Pair
description: Oh children!  This pair of Louis XV chair with ORIGINAL Aubusson upholstery is almost unheard of to find!  nothing can match the patina of real tapestry, nothing!  While these can be used they would need to be used sparingly, the tapestry is in relatively good condition, but with all things this old care should be taken.

title: Napoleon III Walnut Table
description: I love these little barley twist tables, they are classic.  This one imitates the Henri II style (think Catherine de Medici and Diane de Poitiers).  Wonderful rich color that only old hand polished walnut can give.  Perfect as an end table or an entry table to put your keys on.

title: Vintage Copper Weather Vane
description: How cute is this?  This hand made copper weather vane is the perfect thing if you need a lil sumpin-sumpin (especially if your a firefighter)!  mounted on a steel support you can use it as art or for its intended purpose as a weather vane.  Great patina and character.

title: Louis XV Style Table
description: Aint she party?  lovely vintage Louis XV style walnut side table.  The people I bought it from used it as a card table (hence the upholstered top).  The kelly green velvet top is in good shape with a very very light mark on the bottom right quadrant.

title: Gilded Wood Lamps a Pair
description: I love to make lamps out of things, these were very cool MCM tables that were unfortunately un salvageable but the center posts were fab!  So, I had the center drilled and had them made into lamps.  What a beautiful thing they became, the also weight a ton because they are solid wood.  snap these baby's up!

title: French Pastoral Scene
description: Pretty as a picture!  I bought this lovely pastoral in Albi, France, had it cleaned remounted and framed.

title: Chinese Mahogany Demilune Table
description:
The half-moon shape of this table, with its gently curved lines and elegant proportions, adds a touch of sophistication to any room. The demilune design allows for versatile placement against walls making it an ideal piece for entryways, living rooms, or dining areas.

This table features intricately carved details. The timeless appeal of this table with the combination of mahogany wood and traditional design means this table will be a treasured piece for generations to come.

title: Cast Iron Architectural Salvage Lamps a Pair
description: Lord knows I love lamps, especially finding things I can transform into them. I stumbled upon these two 19th century cast iron capitals in Richmond, Va.  I said to my self "self, those would make a cool pair of lamps".  so voila!

title: Erik Buch for Oddense Maskinsnedkeri o.d. Mobler Danish Teak Barstools
description: so, so chic this pair of beautiful teak Eric Buch barstools.  Just. Perfect!

title: Newly Upholstered Adrian Pears All High Back Chair
description: This Mid-Century modern style Adrian Pearsall chair has been newly upholstered in a blue textured fabric.It has armrests and stands on 4 tapered legs. offering a distinctive and stylish addition to any space

title: Louis XVI Style Settee
description: adorable little settee, perfect for the end of the bed to put your shoes on (or for most people a great clothes hanger).  upholstered in bleached duck it is perfectly serviceable or you can personalize it with your choice of upholstery when it arrives chez vous!

title: Italian Two Drawer Neck Classic 18th Century Commode
description: Que Bella!  Thats all I can say about this beautiful 18th century Italian piece.  Fresh from restoration, this bambino is ready to place.

title: Philips Collection Rivers Stone Coffee Table
description: The philips collection river stone coffee table features a unique, organic shape inspired by nature's ability to stones over time, the warm golden hue reflects the light and is a super cool way to add interest and uniqueness to your interior.

title: Monumental Louis XVI Period Buffet
description: this thing was so huge we couldn't get it all in one pic!  constructed of fruitwood with unbeatable patina that only more than 200 years of polish and age can give.  We have all the original keys and locks. this could be the finishing touch or the starting point of you design.  I love this piece, probably my favorite I have had.

title: Louis XVI Style Marquetry Semanier
description: ain't she party?  Lovely Semainer in walnut ebony rosewood and yew.  The top drawer is actually two drawer so, technically this is an 8 drawer chest and not a 7 drawer chest.  Originally clothing for each day of the week was stored in chests like this, hence the name.

title: French 19th Century Tobacco Jar With Floral Design and Snail
description: This is a very sweet tobacco jar with purple flowers and  a snail affixed on the lid. It is unusually shaped and has a vivid light blue interior. Some chipping on the interior of the lid, and minor wear consistent with age and history, as shown in the photos.

title: Enligsh Bone China Salt Cellar with Flowers
description: This in an adorable salt cellar with a very delicate floral decoration on top. Comes with wooden salt spoon. Marked Crown Staffordshire, likely dates from the 1920's. In excellent condition with no chips or cracks.

title: Alabaster Oranges and Lemon - Set of 3
description: These alabaster oranges and lemon have moderate wear to the paint but are still in good condition. The oranges measure 2.75 x 2.75 x 2 and the lemon measures 3 x 2 x 2.25.

title: Alabaster Cherry
description: This sweet little cherry is in good condition and has a green wire stem.

title: Capodimonte Music Box Figurine
description: This is a lovely figurine of a boy with a music box, dating from between 1900-1920. In excellent condition, with no visible cracks or chips.

title: Baccarat Harcourt Pattern Candy Dish
description: This lovely candy dish is in excellent condition. Wonderful for candy and all kinds of decorative items. Dates from 1830's.

title: French Art Deco Cheese Dish in the Style of Lilaque
description: This fantastic art deco cheese dish has sweet bird decorations all the way around. In the style of Lilaque, it has a wonderful frosted quality. It has one rough edge on the bottom of the plate, which is likely from the casting process and not chipping.

title: 19th Century Mandarin Platter
description: This lovely Chinese platter dates from the 1850's and is in good condition. There is a small chip in the rim. There is a four-panel story along the outside with a wonderful central image.

title: Pressed Glass Covered Dish
description: This pressed glass dish is a real treasure. Pressed in three parts, it has a wonderful art deco design and would be a fantastic way to serve snacks or keep your valuables. In good condition with no chips or cracks. Some discoloration in the bottom of the bowl, which could possibly be removed.

title: Louis XVI Style Mirror
description: This is a wow mirror! Gold sculptural details outside the mirror and in the top panel really set it apart. In good condition, with some spots where moulding has come off and mild spotting to the mirror itself. Dates to the 1890's.

title: Glass Column Candlesticks - a Pair
description: This pair of glass column candlesticks date to the 1940's. They are wonderfully simple and in excellent condition.

title: Old Paris Dessert Service - Set of 6
description:
Dessert will never taste as good as it will served from one of these fabulous serving dishes! Includes a wonderful, sculptural fruit bowl, two bowls on pedestals, two trays and a sugar bowl. Dates to the 1830's. 

Fruit bowl has a chip, as shown in photo. Measures 10 in diameter and 7.25 high.
Large footed bowl measures 9.5 in diameter and 5.5 high.
Small footed bowl measures 8.75 in diameter and 3.5 high.
Trays are bowl 12x8.5x 1.
Sugar bowl is attached to the tray and measures 7.5x 9.

title: 19th Century Breton Region Vaisselier
description: This French Vaisselier is easy to date--it's written in nailhead trim on the top of the piece--1889! It has fabulous carving in the shape of ship's wheels, decoration to the metal, and a drawer and two-door cupboard. In good condition, with some wear to the wood, consistent with age.

title: French Mid-Century Modern Rosewood Bar
description:
Stately and elegant but with some flirty metalwork, this bar is fantastic piece of furniture. It has a mirrored back, glass sliding doors and a two door cabinet with sunburst patterned wood and metalwork. It dates from the 1940's. Two small chips to the sliding glass doors and wear to the bottom of the inside of the cabinet, as shown in photos.

This item includes restricted materials and can not be sold outside of the contiguous United States.

title: French 1940's Frosted Floral Glass Vase With Brass Setting
description: This sweet and charming frosted glass vase has floral details and lovely brass fittings on the top and bottom. Some damage where the brass has scratched against the glass, but overall in good condition.

title: Sarreguemines French Military Life Plates - Set of 7
description: Five original designs (duplicates of two) depicting French military life. Excellent condition, except for one chip on one plate, as shown in photos.

title: French Empire Solid Mahogany Four Drawer Chest
description: This fabulous period mahogany chest of drawers has wonderful columns, bronze hardware and a gray marble top. In good condition, with some wear to the wood and a few scratches to the marble, as shown in photos. Insides of drawers do have some cracks, probably due to changes in temperature. Dates to circa 1815.

title: Antique Louis XVIII Period Side Chairs With 19th Century Upholstery - a Pair
description: These chairs were solidly made in the 1710's--hence why they're still around today! Recovered between 1870 and 1890, they have a little war and tear to the upholstery, but the Louis XVIII-style legs are in excellent condition.

title: 19th Century French Napoleon III Bronze Andirons - a Pair
description: These fabulous andirons have intricate detailing and are in excellent condition. They date from the 1880's.

title: 19th Century Louis XVI Style Bronze Andirons - Set of 3
description: This lovely three-piece bronze andiron set is decorated with flowers and flourishes, making it exceedingly elegant. Dates to the 1880's and is in good condition, with minor tarnish to the bronze.

title: French Louis XVI Brass Chenet - 3 Pieces
description: All of the detail in this exquisite chenet set screams Louis XVI! In good condition, with some tarnish and a dent in the center piece. Dates from ca. 1880.

title: Miniature Old Paris Vases - a Pair
description: Everything we love about Old Paris vases--the gilding, white porcelain and sculptural elements--in miniature! These sweet vases are perfect for displaying buds or all by themselves. Dating from the 1890's, they have wear to the gilding and painted decoration, as shown in photos.

title: Old Paris Painted and Gilded Vase
description: This Old Paris vase has some of the finest decoration we've seen--the painted flowers and the gilding are truly exquisite. In excellent condition, with no chips, cracks or breaks--only wear to the gilding.

title: Cast Iron Bull Dog Bank
description: A whimsical 1920s cast iron bulldog bank figurine, painted grey with a charmingly snaggletoothed expression and wonderful old patina. A fun figural collectible for any dog lover.

title: Vintage Wrigley Building Scotty Dog Souvenir
description: Vintage Wrigley Building Scotty Dog Souvenir

title: St. Louis Crystal Bonbonier
description: These people must have gotten this as a wedding present and never used it.  It was in it's original packing box with straw stuffing.  It shines like new (because, of course it essentially is).  It is also rare to find these with the under plate still together.   I found this little lovely at a house sale in the southwest of France.

title: Set of 12 French Horn, Sterling and Steel Knives
description:
Wowza!  Hard to find set of twelve Napoleon III knife set with its original box.  The Horn handles are delicately carved to resemble branches.
This item includes restricted materials and cannot be sold outside of the contiguous United States.

title: Louis XV Style Arm Chair With Aubusson Tapestry
description: Wowza!  what to say?  the perfectly preserved Napoleon III Louis XV style arm chair has the original Aubusson tapestry upholstery in wonderful condition.  Just slightly decadent, this curvy beauty is ready to grace any interior from MCM to traditional.

title: French Bronze Empire Clock
description: All Hail Diana, Goddess of War!  this wonderful French Empire bronze clock is classic, stylish and ads just that little touch of mystery to your interior as people try to decide which Goddess it depicts.  Great conversation and statement piece, works well.

title: Charles X Painted Tole Lamp
description: Wonder mustard yellow marks this Charles X period oil lamp that has been newly re-wired.  It has that perfect touch of color that every room needs.

title: Capodimonte Porcelain Statue of a French Imperial Soldier
description: charming statue of a Napoleonic Soldier

title: Louis XV Period Side Chair
description: I bought this last summer in France at one of my favorite brocante's near Toulouse, It called to me to be saved.  The frame is in wonderful original shape but the cane left something to be desired, I didn't have time to have someone do it in France, but I found a wonderful artisan here in the area (the people who do this are a dying breed).  She did a wonderful job, I didn't have the cane colored as it will darken with age.  As with all 18th century French seating it is rather low since folks were considerable smaller back then, this can easily be remedied with a cushion.

title: 19th Century Walnut Chair
description: I love furniture when you can change the upholstery with the seasons, my grandmother used to change her drapes and slipcovers with the seasons, I am far too lazy for that though.  The back and seat of this chair can lift out and be changed easily.  The current upholstery is a beige linen that has some water stains.  The frame is in excellent shape and is ready to be used on a daily basis.

title: Copper Samovar
description: A lot of the White Russians ended up in France (after all they spoke the language) after the 1st World War.  This copper piece dates to this time period,

title: French Landscape
description: Lovely little landscape in the barbizon style dejecting a tranquil river.  ahhhhhhhh relaxing

title: French Mortar
description: I suspect by the wear that this is older than I am listing it as, this would look stunning with some moss and orchids in it.

title: Late 19th Century Napoleon Brass Andirons- a Pair
description: need a little bling for the winter?  These Louis XVI style andirons fit the bill!  Great for Gas fireplaces as well.

title: Cast Iron Architectural Salvage Lamps a Pair
description: whelp, when I saw these lying around my fav junk shop in Virginia, my lamp obsession took over and I had to have em.  Voila the result!  The back story is that these were salvaged from a building in downtown Richmond that was being demolished and they bought them there.  They date to the last quarter of the 19th century.  I think they would be perfect for a library office or on a sofa table, but I'll let you decide!

title: Napoleon III Vase
description: I just love this hand painted Medici Vase by the French company Gien.  The delicate, romantic scenery is done in browns and creams and is hand signed by the artist.

title: Napoleon 3rd Desk Chair
description: astonishing comfortable (so people tell me), this Napoleon III desk chair in the with it ORGINAL LEATHER is the bomb.  constructed of solid cuban mahogany it has withstood the test of time and will be the perfect addition to your home office.

title: Louis Phillipe Walnut Refraisesoire
description: how cool is this?  Louis-Philippe wine table super rare has a little drawer for wine stuff (that's a technical term) hand crafted of walnut and dressed with pyrenees marble this baby will bit anywhere.  Put a glass top and fill the dried flowers or champaign corks and display it in your wine cellar.

title: Louis XVI Style Lamp
description: Need a little bling to lighten up those dreary days?  This hand carved example fits the bill!

title: Maitland Smith Console
description: Ya know, ya never know what is going to walk (or get wheeled) into the shop.  This lovely Maitland Smith console is a prime example!  beautiful bronze accents and patinated wrought iron, what a statement!

title: 18th Century Italian Chest of Drawers
description: Ciao Bella!  That's exactly what comes to mind every time I look at this beauty.  Fresh from restoration (don't worry, we showed restraint), this bambino has officially reached Mount Olympus status.  The gods may have had thrones, but i'd argue they would've happily settled for this. Elegant, timeless, and just dramatic enough to steal every scene it enters. Some furniture fills a room.... This one rules it.

title: Maitland Smith Style Bronze Monkey Table
description: who docent love a monkey?! This probably Maitland-Smith one is so cute!  He can be a place to put yer keys, or to greet you in the mornings on your way to work in the front hall.

title: Louis XVI Console Game Table
description: fresh from restoration, this absolutely lovely Louis XVI period console game table is the cat's meow!

title: Saxe-Gotha German Faience Vases - a Pair
description: ca. 1890-1900, German. Excellent exterior. Minor interior cracking consistent with age and use.

title: Plaster Pricket Lamp
description: This plaster pricket lamp, dating from the 1960's, is painted gray and was a new white shade. It was been newly rewired for safety. The base measures 11" x 11",  while the shade was a diameter of 18". In excellent condition, with minor wear as shown in photos.

title: 19th Century French Pricket Lamps - a Pair
description: Stately bronze lamps dating from the 1870's. Newly rewired and outfitted with new neutral shades. Good condition, as shown in photos, with minor wear consistent with age, as shown in photos. Base measures 8"x8", shade measures 20" diameter.

title: Napoleon III Bronze and Crystal Sconces - A Pair
description: Dating from the 1890's, these exquisite scones have been recently rewired for safety and to easily plugged in to a two prong outlet.

title: French Sconces with Porcelain Flowers - A Pair
description: Dating from the 1920's, these wall sconces have the most interesting floral decorations, organically placed on the candle holders. In good condition, with some damage to the paint on the metal, but not to the flowers.

title: Louis XV Period Commode with Serpentine Front
description: This piece dates all the way from 1750 and is in a very loved, very good condition. It has wonderful, glowing patina that only 250 years of hand-rubbed waxing can give.

title: French Mid-Century Modern Metal Letter "O"
description: This fabulous metal letter O came from an outdoor sign in France. It is painted a lovely lilac purple, which also reads as a periwinkle. In good condition, with a dent to the top left side.

title: French 19th Century Wrought Iron Bronze and Brass Sconces a Pair
description: Absolutely Unusual pair of French 1940s sconces..... I can hear those silk sheath dresses rustling and the ice in those cocktails clinking! Found in a house sale in France (prior to its demolition) I was able to snag the matching chandelier. These have been restored and re-wired and are ready for installation.

title: Louis XVI Style Arm Chairs a Pair
description: Sleek and casual, but not too casual, newly upholstered in neutral ivory fabric that goes with anything.  The gold accents on the arms add a little touch of glamour.

title: 19th Century Louis XVI Style Sconces a Pair
description: I LOVE how these turned out!  The lovely bronze dorè Louis XV 4 arm sconces weren't wired for electricity when I found them in France this summer.  With a little elbow grease and some imagination, these are perfect for that contemporary or traditional interior.  The backplates were added to bring them up to code and I think they work very well together.  All they need is a new home!

title: Louis Philippe “encoinures” Corner Cabinets - a Pair
description:
when I saw these, I couldn't believe my eyes!  In France it is almost impossible to find pairs of anything since things get divided up so often in families because of the inheritance
laws there.  These Louis-Philippe Mahogany corner cabinets are fashioned out of book matched mahogany and walnut, the patina on them is a deep gloss like they have been dipped in honey that only almost 200 years of car and waxing can give.

title: Napoleon 3 Black Lacquered Table W/ Marble Top
description: Well, who doesn't like black and white together, this napoleon III writing table in glossy restored black lacquer topped with white restored marble, makes a wonderful statement or an anchor piece to design your room around.

title: Arts and Crafts Umbrella Stand
description: how beautiful is this?  I love this lapis blue on this umber's stand.  it came within two shakes of going into my house, but, since I break stuff (or the vacuum robot does, that's my story and I'm sticking to it) I am letting it go to a good home.

title: Old Master Dutch Style Painting
description: So This is a perfect example of "bang for the buck"!  This reproduction painting is a wonderful example of the Dutch old master still life, full of rich colors and a perfect choice for the maximalist interior or that super simple purified interior that just needs a focal point.

title: Hepplewhite Leather Top Table
description: Diana Vreeland always said a round table is perfect for dinner parties because everyone is equal in distance and makes an evening more convivial.  I agree.  This Georgian Hepplewhite style leather topped dining table is a perfect candidate for this.  Lovely patina, beautiful color and just the right amount of gloss. Unfortunately, the leaves have been lost over the years but who would really use them?

title: French Regency Style Buffet
description: beautiful terracotta color marble on this baby marries perfectly with the oak.  Great patina and shape.

title: Louis XV Buffet
description: pretty as a picture!  This early 19th Louis XV style buffet is probably from the north of France, we know this by the wood (oak) used in the construction.  This piece has wonderful patina and we're keeping it warm while it waits for its new home!

title: Italian Gilt Settee
description: well.... this is glamour personified!  I can just picture the Venetian Villa where this started life in the 19th century.  This lovely piece is in the perfect state of gentrified decay.  while the upholstery needs to be updated, the support system is in excellent shape.

title: Pair of Terracotta Candle Sticks “Summer” and “Autumn”
description: wonderful mounted on bronze terracotta candelabra.

title: French 19th Century "Banjo Clock"
description: welcome to the 19th century!  This "banjo clock" has been painted to look like mahogany.  In France it is called a "comatose".  This one was made in Toulouse and sat in my house in France for 20 years before i brought it into the shop.  It functions and has a servants ring (which means it rings twice).  great for the entry way or to grace the end of a hallway.

title: American Empire Secretary
description: The best of the post Civil War style!  This impressive secretary retains its original finish and velvet writing surfaces.  The perfect thing for those who need a multiple use piece of furniture.  Clad in book matched Cuban mahogany, it has a depth of color and patina that you cannot find in todays furniture.

title: Hollywood Regency Glass and Gilt Side Tables a Pair
description: can't you just see Joan Crawford sitting down with a glass of vodka and ice after a long day of beating her children?  Ultra cool from a fabulous beach estate here in Virginia, purchased new in 1969.

title: Pair of Baker Furniture for Michael Taylor Screen Back Slipper Chairs
description: Sleek, timeless and undeniably chic_ these iconic slipper chairs by legendary designer Michael Taylor embody mid-century sophistication with a modern edge. Featuring clean architectural lines, a distinctive screen-back silhouette, and freshly upholstered in a soft neutral fabric, they strike a perfect balance between comfort and style. These chairs are ideal for the design-savvy buyer looking to invest in true American design heritage.

title: Hand Carved Wooden Chain Lamps
description: I love making lamps out of things.  I saw these carved wooden chains, I thought oooohhhhh coooolll Lamps!  so I made 4.  buy one two or all four that are available.
